data.narrative:
Valthos, a Seed-stage company in Defense & Security led by Kathleen McMahon and Tess van Stekelenburg, has raised $30M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers (2 public, 8 private) operating in the same sector and stage band, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $30M total raised as a value proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $75M. Peer-Median analysis benchmarks against four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A). The median valuation across these four peers is $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $64M to $805M, with a median of $388M. The wide range reflects material dispersion within the Defense & Security peer set—a sector experiencing significant variance in funding patterns and exit multiples. Key uncertainties include stage-specific funding velocity, product differentiation relative to better-capitalized competitors, and regulatory pathway clarity. The $388M midpoint is supported if Valthos demonstrates comparable technical maturity and market traction to mid-tier Series A peers.
